Write, run and rank the candidates of a model suggestion

Source: R/nm_suggest_run.R
nm_suggest_run.Rd

Writes the control streams of the chosen candidates of nm_suggest_model() with nm_write_ctl() (from = x), launches them with nm_run(), reads their objective function value and ranks them by BIC (OFV + number of estimated parameters x log(number of observations)). The rank by BIC is compared with the rank of the data-driven score (Spearman correlation), which shows whether the suggestion anticipated the NONMEM result. A lag time of a candidate is added after $PK as ALAG1 = THETA(n) with its initial value, since nm_write_ctl() writes none.

Usage

nm_suggest_run(
  x,
  analysis_dir,
  nmfe_path = NULL,
  candidates = 1:3,
  prefix = "sugg",
  data = NULL,
  run = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  n_cores = 1L,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'nm_suggest_run'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An nm_model_suggestion object.

analysis_dir

Analysis directory where the control streams are written and run. It must contain the dataset, or data must point to it.

nmfe_path

Path to the nmfe launcher (see nm_run()).

candidates

Candidate numbers (default: the first 3).

prefix

Prefix of the control stream names (<prefix><n>.ctl).

data

Dataset file name written in $DATA (default: the file analysed by nm_suggest_model()), relative to analysis_dir or absolute.

run

If FALSE, only the control streams are written.

overwrite

Replace existing control streams and adapted datasets, and run the candidates again even when a previous run of the same name has terminated (otherwise nm_run() skips it and its old results are read).

verbose

Print progress messages.

n_cores

Number of candidates run at the same time, passed to nm_run() (default 1).

...

Further arguments passed to nm_write_ctl() (e.g. method).

Value

An object of class nm_suggest_run: a data.frame with one row per candidate (candidate, model, score, rank_score, ctl, data (dataset used), ofv, n_par, n_obs, bic, rank_bic, min_ok), with the Spearman correlation between score and BIC ranks in attribute spearman and the nm_run() log in attribute log.

Details

Each candidate gets a dataset that matches its compartment numbering: doses in the depot (CMT 1) and observations in the central compartment (CMT 2) for first-order and transit absorption (ADVAN2/4/12 or ODE); doses and observations in the central compartment (CMT 1) for IV and zero-order input (ADVAN1/3/11), with RATE = -2 on the doses for a modelled zero-order duration (D1). When the original dataset does not match, a copy <data>_<prefix><n>.csv is written in analysis_dir (records copied verbatim, only CMT and RATE changed); the original file is never modified. Datasets with several observed compartments (parent and metabolite, PK and PD) or doses by several routes are not handled: the function stops.

See also

nm_suggest_model(), nm_write_ctl(), nm_run()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
s <- nm_suggest_model("C:/nm76g64/run/etude/data.csv")
r <- nm_suggest_run(s, analysis_dir = "C:/nm76g64/run/etude",
                    nmfe_path = "C:/nm76g64/run/nmfe76.bat", candidates = 1:4)
r
} # }
